title: Connect readers and calculations
intro: A class groups state and methods. new Board(tasks) calls its constructor and creates an instance. Composition means combining small operations with clear inputs and outputs.

steps.text: The constructor stores the original count. value() returns it. The field title is public and readonly. The code calls value(), then passes its result to a normal function. This separates retrieving data from transforming it. An async reader follows the same division, with await at the boundary.
